title: Revamped Trident

body:
# Revamped-Trident
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7417d6febac1fb42851bcc5fa3da400c853c1ae8.png)
**Revamped Trident improves the vanilla Trident with improved stats, functionality, tweaks and more... This mod aims to keep the "Vanilla" feel of the Original Trident**

## Features / Additions 
- Craftable Trident recipe
- New Advancement: Lord of the Seas
- Tridents now always dropped from Drowned
- Repair Tridents using Prismarine Shards in an anvil
- Improved Channeling functionality with now working in Rain not only Thunderstorms
- Improved Riptide functionality with extended charging and similar function to the "Transcending Trident" Mod

_The goal of this mod is to make Tridents more useful and less annoying to obtain and maintain without changing them too much._

_Made for players who want Tridents to feel like an actual weapon worth using for PVP & General-Use._

> Textures, Fabric-Port, and More soon...

**_[Made for Neoforge.1.21.1] (W.I.P)_**
